hebrewText: וְ/כ֤וֹבַע נְחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ עַל רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ וְ/שִׁרְי֥וֹן קַשְׂקַשִּׂ֖ים ה֣וּא לָב֑וּשׁ וּ/מִשְׁקַל֙ הַ/שִּׁרְי֔וֹן חֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִ֥ים שְׁקָלִ֖ים נְחֹֽשֶֽׁת

tokens.bdb: copper, hence, something made of that metal, i.e. coin, a fetter; figuratively, base (as compared with gold or silver)
tokens.kjv: brasen, brass, chain, copper, fetter (of brass), filthiness, steel.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
tokens.kjv: band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief(-est place, man, things), company, end, [idiom] every (man), excellent, first, forefront, (be-)head, height, (on) high(-est part, (priest)), [idiom] lead, [idiom] poor, principal, ruler, sum, top.
breastplate, coat of mail, habergeon, harness. See H5630 (סִרְיֹן).

tokens.bdb: a scale (of a fish); hence a coat of mail (as composed of or covered with jointed plates of metal)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a scale ; hence a coat of mail

tokens.explanationEn: a scale ; hence a coat of mail

tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.

tokens.bdb: properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on agarment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively
tokens.kjv: (in) apparel, arm, array (self), clothe (self), come upon, put (on, upon), wear.
breastplate, coat of mail, habergeon, harness. See H5630 (סִרְיֹן).
